w1_last_guard.name: Last Guard
w1_last_guard.text: One-use defensive burst. Exiled after play.

w1_second_wind.name: Second Wind
w1_second_wind.text: One-use recovery and protection. Exiled after play.

w1_solar_burst.name: Solar Burst
w1_solar_burst.text: One-use strike with a stronger residual. Exiled after play.

w1_scorch.name: Scorch Cut
w1_scorch.text: Immediate damage plus a short residual.

w1_release.name: Condense
w1_release.text: Consume all Scorch/Corrosion potency in one proc at 150%; not remaining-duration damage.

w1_lance.name: Critical Lance
w1_lance.text: Card-local +75 critical chance; supports guaranteed tiers.

w1_flurry.name: Twin Blades
w1_flurry.text: One shared budget split into two independent crit rolls.

w1_barrage.name: Shard Barrage
w1_barrage.text: Shared source budget; four per-impact rolls.

w1_sweep.name: Arc Sweep
w1_sweep.text: Pays for coverage rather than single-target burst.

w1_bulwark.name: Bulwark
w1_bulwark.text: Efficient defense, at the cost of offensive tempo.

w1_reserve.name: Guard reserve
w1_reserve.text: Defend now and store a future Block proc.

w1_release_guard.name: Release Guard
w1_release_guard.text: Consumes defense reserve, not damage stacks.

w1_dampen.name: Dampen
w1_dampen.text: Reduce one actor's outgoing damage instead of racing it.

w1_catalyst.name: Volatile Catalyst
w1_catalyst.text: Captured residual potency scales at application, not again on release.

w1_venom_flurry.name: Venom Flurry
w1_venom_flurry.text: Multiple hits plus one status application, not one free payload per hit.

w1_detonate.name: Detonating Cut
w1_detonate.text: Cash-out before attacking; avoids a duplicate tick.

w1_riposte.name: Guard Conversion
w1_riposte.text: Consumes own Block after converting 75% into an attack.

w1_pierce.name: Piercing Ray
w1_pierce.text: Trade base damage for ignoring Block.

w1_rehearse.name: Rehearsed Strike
w1_rehearse.text: Critical/draw sidegrade unlocked after reaching world-one completion.

w1_renewal.name: Lasting Renewal
w1_renewal.text: A second limited recovery option; unlock, not permanent stats.

w1_power_surge.name: Power Surge
w1_power_surge.text: Gain 2 Energy, up to its maximum. Exile.

w1_blood_fuel.name: Blood Fuel
w1_blood_fuel.text: Pay 4 Health, leaving at least 1. Gain 2 Energy. Exile.

w1_charge_cell.name: Charge Cell
w1_charge_cell.text: Store 2 Energy potency for a later release. Exile.

w1_release_charge.name: Release Charge
w1_release_charge.text: Consume all your Energy reserves; gain their potency once, up to maximum Energy.

w1_guarded_strike.name: Guarded Strike
w1_guarded_strike.text: Deal 4 + 50% of current Block as damage. Keep your Block.

w1_guard_wave.name: Guard Wave
w1_guard_wave.text: Deal 50% of current Block to each enemy, then consume your Block once.

w1_shelter.name: Shelter
w1_shelter.text: Recover 2 Health + 10% of current Block. Exile.

w1_cinder_brand.name: Cinder Brand
w1_cinder_brand.text: Apply 3 captured fire potency for 4 enemy end activations.

w1_volatile_rot.name: Volatile Rot
w1_volatile_rot.text: Apply 6 captured poison potency for 1 enemy end activation.

w1_caustic_guard.name: Caustic Guard
w1_caustic_guard.text: Gain 3 Block. Apply 2 captured poison potency for 2 enemy end activations.

w1_lingering_aegis.name: Lingering Aegis
w1_lingering_aegis.text: Gain captured 3 Block at the start of your next 2 activations.

w1_mending_echo.name: Mending Echo
w1_mending_echo.text: Recover captured 2 Health at the start of your next 3 activations. Exile.

w1_release_mending.name: Release Mending
w1_release_mending.text: Consume all compatible healing payloads for one recovery equal to their potency, not their remaining ticks.

w1_delayed_recovery.name: Delayed Recovery
w1_delayed_recovery.text: Recover captured 8 Health at the start of your next activation, once. Exile.

w1_seek_attack.name: Seek Attack
w1_seek_attack.text: Move up to 1 attack card(s) from draw to hand, in zone order.

w1_gather_defense.name: Gather Defense
w1_gather_defense.text: Move up to 2 defense card(s) from draw to hand, in zone order.

w1_recover_trace.name: Recover Trace
w1_recover_trace.text: Move up to 1 residual card(s) from discard to hand, in zone order.

w1_prepare_guard.name: Prepare Guard
w1_prepare_guard.text: Move up to 1 defense card(s) from discard to draw, in zone order.

w1_needle_storm.name: Needle Storm
w1_needle_storm.text: Deal 2 base damage per hit, 3 hits. Each hit rolls critical tiers separately.

w1_heavy_impact.name: Heavy Impact
w1_heavy_impact.text: Deal 28 base damage in one impact.

w1_break_guard.name: Break Guard
w1_break_guard.text: Remove 8 Block (fixed, no critical or Armor), then deal 4 base Health damage.

w1_relay_strike.name: Relay Strike
w1_relay_strike.text: Deal 14 base damage. On a kill, excess continues to one more enemy without reapplying source bonuses.

condensation_labels.w1_release_dot: Consume compatible offensive residuals: release 150% of captured potency once.
condensation_labels.w1_release_guard: Consume all Guard reserve stacks: gain 150% of stored potency as Block.
condensation_labels.w1_release_charge: Consume your Energy reserves: gain their captured potency once.
condensation_labels.w1_release_mending: Consume your healing payloads: recover their captured potency once.

card_flow_labels.w1_seek_attack: Find an Attack in the draw pile
card_flow_labels.w1_gather_defense: Find up to two Defense cards in the draw pile
card_flow_labels.w1_recover_trace: Recover a residual producer from discard
card_flow_labels.w1_prepare_guard: Put a Defense card from discard on top of the draw pile
